title: Josiah Finds God's Word
summary: Josiah Finds God's Word is a short lesson with one main thread: God's Word can wake up hearts and call people back to Him. When you realize you were wrong, Josiah shows that a soft heart responds instead of making excuses.

read_it.prompt: Read 2 Kings 22:1-13. Notice one detail that would help a kid explain Josiah Finds God's Word to someone else.

tell_it: Josiah listened when God's Book was found and read. King Josiah heard the Book of the Law and was sorry for Israel's sin. He wanted the people to listen to God. The pressure in the scene helps the lesson feel real.
understand_it: Kids can understand Josiah Finds God's Word by asking what was at stake, what God revealed, and what response was faithful. God's Word can wake up hearts and call people back to Him.
age_5_7_explanation: Josiah listened when God's Book was found and read.
age_8_11_explanation: King Josiah heard the Book of the Law and was sorry for Israel's sin. He wanted the people to listen to God. Kids can practice retelling it with the beginning, hard moment, and God-centered ending.
teen_explanation: God's Word can wake up hearts and call people back to Him. A teen discussion can press into why the story mattered then and how the same truth can reshape choices now.
key_truths: God's Word can wake up hearts and call people back to Him.
Josiah Finds God's Word shows God's Word through a real Bible moment, not a slogan.
When you realize you were wrong, Josiah shows that a soft heart responds instead of making excuses.
life_application: When you realize you were wrong, Josiah shows that a soft heart responds instead of making excuses.

quiz_questions.question: Which answer keeps Josiah Finds God's Word connected to the actual passage?
choices: The book was a map to treasure
quiz_questions.explanation: The Book of the Law is the story detail to remember. The bigger lesson grows out of that detail instead of floating away from the passage.

quiz_questions.question: Name the pressure, problem, or need in Josiah Finds God's Word.
quiz_questions.answer: Answers should name the story's real challenge and connect it to God's response.
quiz_questions.explanation: Good retelling notices what was hard before jumping straight to the takeaway.

memory_verse.prompt: Memorize or repeat 2 Kings 22:11 as the Bible handle for this lesson.

discussion_questions: Who needed help, courage, correction, or mercy in Josiah Finds God's Word?
What truth should a kid remember after reading Josiah Finds God's Word?
How can the group pray about Josiah Finds God's Word without using pretend-perfect answers?

activity.title: Rediscovered Word Scroll
activity.instructions: Roll paper like a scroll and write one command or truth from Scripture to obey.

prayer_prompt: Lord, use Josiah Finds God's Word to teach my heart, not just my memory. Help me take one faithful next step after reading Josiah Finds God's Word.
